verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is managed sandbox infrastructure that AI agents run inside; it is not itself an agent that consumes tools, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this kind of product. The 'remote MCP controls' doc (docs-16) is a network policy that governs MCP traffic leaving the sandbox. It does not show the product plugging in MCP servers to use their tools, so it does not make this axis applicable.
